grounded.context: review statement, UV-induced caspase-dependent PCD system
grounded.evidence_quote: In this particular caspase-dependent PCD system, H2AX phosphorylation at Ser139 is mediated by c-Jun NH2-terminal kinase 1 (JNK1), a member of the mitogen-activated protein kinase group.
In sum, along caspase-dependent PCD, histone H2AX can be phosphorylated at Ser139 by MST1, JNK, or PIKKs.
